_comment: Invented, generic user requests labelled with the hub/skills a careful reader would load. 'expected' must be suggested for full recall; 'acceptable' may be suggested without counting as a false positive. An empty 'expected' is a negative: nothing should be suggested. Labels may name skills another change adds: a name not on disk is dropped, and a case whose expected skills are all missing is skipped. Every skill on disk needs at least one case. Used by tests/unit/test_skill_suggester.py.
